kyoto_pontocho_suishin_honten.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai sets, Kyoto-vegetable courses, nama-fu dengaku, agedashi tofu, tempura, kamameshi and shabu-shabu; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_pontocho_suishin_honten.vegan_detail: Ask. Many Kyoto-vegetable and tofu dishes, but dashi is not described (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_pontocho_suishin_honten.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:15; last entry 22:00) daily (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog; 2026). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 105 seats over two floors, with private rooms for 6 to 30 and a counter (Tabelog; August 2026). In a machiya on Pontocho south of Sanjo, about 5 min from Keihan Sanjo (Tabelog).
kyoto_pontocho_suishin_honten.notes: [Obanzai and kaiseki · Pontocho machiya, Kyoto vegetables] A big, calm two-storey machiya on Pontocho with a counter and private rooms, serving obanzai sets, nama-fu dengaku and kamameshi à la carte, and Kyoto-vegetable courses from ¥4,950 — seasonal touches like matsutake-and-hamo dobin-mushi in autumn. Good for families and celebrations.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s invoice number T8130001022725 is registered to 株式会社黛 of Kyoto (NTA register). Our crawl also lists 京すいしん and 炭火焼酒房 すいしん; how many shops the company runs was not established. Reviewers praise attentive staff who explain the ingredients (August and October 2026).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 family shared a laugh with the staff over what obanzai means, then shared a five-dish set and kamameshi.
An October 2026 trio of mother, brother and diner, rarely drinkers, ended up ordering drinks over matsutake kamameshi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 先斗町すいしん 本店、日本料理・海鮮・居酒屋、中京区先斗町三条下ル材木町181、京阪三条駅から徒歩5分、毎日17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:15、最終入店22:00)、カード可、105席、6〜30名の個室、京町家、京野菜とおばんざい、京の味覚コース「嵐山」4,950円、会席「桃山」5,500円から、適格請求書 T8130001022725 (株式会社黛)。口コミ (2026年、英語): 「加茂」コース (松茸と鱧の土瓶蒸し、子持ち鮎の塩焼き、蕪と鮎の湯葉あん)、おばんざい5種盛り、揚げ出し豆腐、茄子や生麩の田楽、とうもろこしの天ぷら、松茸の釜飯、だし巻き、京都ポークと野菜のしゃぶしゃぶ、湯葉とトマトのゼリー、カウンターの実演、京都の地酒。

cultural_comfort.note: Large machiya with private rooms; staff explain dishes.

kyoto_gion_plum.gf_detail: Ask. French-based teppan and à la carte — steaks, abalone steak with bread, gratins, onion gratin soup, tempura of mino, pilaf; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_plum.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Wagyu, abalone, oysters, tongue and offal (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_plum.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday and holidays 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); closed Sunday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Service charge 10% (Tabelog, original サービス料10%). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: a counter on the left and two tables for four (Tabelog; February 2026). Now at street level on Gion-machi Kitagawa after a move (September 2026), about 5 min from Keihan Gion-Shijo (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_plum.notes: [Teppan bistro · Gion Kitagawa, abalone and Wagyu] A small machiya counter and two tables in Gion where chefs cook French-leaning dishes on the teppan in front of you — a much-loved abalone steak, filet and tongue, oyster gratins, onion soup and a garlic pilaf — à la carte. 10% service charge; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text describes skilled chefs cooking Wagyu and abalone steaks before guests in a machiya, with French-based creative dishes of Kyoto ingredients. A September 2026 regular notes the restaurant has moved to a street-level site.

anecdotes.text: A January 2025 visitor who comes to Kyoto once a year was thrilled by fried fish as the first nibble and finished with the special pilaf.
An October 2025 regular back after a long gap found the place packed, but missed the matsutake that year.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 祇園 ぷらむ、鉄板焼き・ビストロ、東山区祇園町北側259-1、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、月〜土・祝 17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、日曜定休、サービス料10%、カード可、20席、町家、京都の食材のフレンチがベースの創作料理、目の前で焼く和牛や鮑のステーキ。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 鮑のステーキとパン、フィレステーキ、牛のたたき、オニオングラタンスープ、牡蠣のグラタン、ガーリックライス、ミノの天ぷら、焼き牡蠣、牛タンの焼き物とシチュー、特製ピラフ、蟹酢、人数に合わせた刺身とサラダ、移転して1階の店に。

cultural_comfort.note: 10% service charge; counter cooking.

kyoto_sushi_kita_no_sachi.gf_detail: Ask. Omakase of sushi and Hokkaido seafood — hairy crab, scallops, herring-roe rolls; soy sauce not described (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_kita_no_sachi.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 18:00–2:00; closed Sunday; hours may change (Tabelog). No menu — the chef’s omakase (March 2026). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). On Gion-machi Kitagawa, about 240 m from Gion-Shijo Station (Tabelog).
kyoto_sushi_kita_no_sachi.notes: [Sushi · Gion Kitagawa, Hokkaido seafood late] A Gion sushi counter serving Hokkaido and northern fish as omakase — hairy crab, scallops, a herring-roe roll — from a kind chef who explains each piece, open until 2:00. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: A March 2026 reviewer describes a kind chef who explains each dish and ingredients mostly from Hokkaido and the north; a September 2025 regular calls it a usual haunt.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 visitor, on a second stop, was surprised to find Hokkaido flavours in Kyoto and took the chef’s omakase.
Another March 2026 diner singled out a herring-roe sushi roll as something found only here.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: すし処 北の幸、寿司、東山区祇園町北側256、祇園四条駅から241m、月〜土 18:00〜翌2:00、日曜定休、カード可 (JCB・AMEX・Diners)。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 北海道や北の産地の魚介、品書きのないおまかせ、旬の毛蟹、ほたて、数の子の巻物、説明してくれる優しい大将、2〜3万円ほど。

kyoto_nagisa_club.gf_detail: Ask. A cocktail bar — fruit cocktails and a few sweets; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_nagisa_club.vegan_detail: Ask. Fresh-fruit cocktails, some with yogurt (2026 reviews).
kyoto_nagisa_club.hours_raw: Monday and Wednesday–Sunday 18:00–3:00; closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Charge ¥300 (Tabelog, original チャージ300円). Cards including UnionPay; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 28 seats with tables (Tabelog; January 2026). In the basement of the World Kaikan, just west of where the 南大黒橋通 lane leaves Kiyamachi, 5 min from Keihan Sanjo (Tabelog; May 2026). Founded in 1956 (May 2026 review).
kyoto_nagisa_club.notes: [Cocktail bar · off Kiyamachi, since 1956] A surprisingly calm, retro basement bar off Kiyamachi, said to date from 1956, mixing fresh-fruit cocktails — gin and tonic, raspberry yogurt, salty dog, espresso martini — and alcohol-free versions, with fresh chocolate. ¥300 charge; open until 3:00; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: A May 2026 reviewer calls it an authentic bar in business since 1956; a January 2026 visitor was greeted by a polite, gentle bartender.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 group of four, unsure of space, found a table free and had a non-alcoholic kiwi frozen-yogurt cocktail.

kyoto_yakiniku_marutomi_shijo.gf_detail: Ask. Yakiniku with sauces, salt and wasabi; Korean cold noodles and bibimbap also on the menu; no gluten information is published (official site; reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_marutomi_shijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakiniku restaurant. Grilled vegetables are on the menu (official site).
kyoto_yakiniku_marutomi_shijo.hours_raw: Lunch 11:00–14:30 (last order 13:45); dinner 17:00–22:00 (food last order 21:00, drinks 21:30); open every day (official site; Tabelog). Reservations taken, 2-hour seating limit; courses from 2 people, book the day before (Tabelog; official site). Cards and PayPay accepted (Tabelog). Service charge: Tabelog’s English note says 10%, but its Japanese original says none — ask. 34 seats: counter, tables, sofa seats and a tatami room by the window overlooking Shijo Kawaramachi; non-smoking; English menu (Tabelog; official site). Lunch rice refills free (official site; 2026 reviews). On the 8th floor of Kyoto Kawaramachi Garden, 1 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (official site).
kyoto_yakiniku_marutomi_shijo.notes: [Yakiniku · Shijo Kawaramachi, butcher-run, 8th-floor view] A yakiniku room high above the Shijo Kawaramachi crossing, run by a Kyoto butcher that has bought whole cattle since 1953 — Kumamoto akaushi and kuroge wagyu, cut by hand. Window tatami seats look over the city at night. Lunch sets from ¥1,300 with free rice refills; a "meat cake" for birthdays. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: The official site says Marutomi began as a butcher, founded in 1953, that buys whole carcasses of Saga, Miyazaki and Shikoku Saburo beef; the owner goes to select each animal, and the head chef trained at top hotels and bars. The restaurant opened in July 2017 (Tabelog). An October 2026 reviewer adds that the butcher has one shop in Kyoto and one in Shiga.
chef_bio.philosophy: Whole-carcass buying lets high-grade meat be served for less; cuts are hand-sliced to suit each piece (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Kumamoto akaushi and kuroge wagyu yakiniku; rare cuts such as hiuchi.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 regular surprised a friend with the meat cake for a coming-of-age celebration.
A June 2026 guest treated a parent to the Tamatebako course for a retirement celebration.
An April 2026 diner found the cuts good with salt and wasabi as well as the sauces, and liked the window seats over the night view.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 焼肉まる富、京都市下京区四条通河原町東入真町68 京都河原町ガーデン8F、阪急河原町駅から徒歩1分、祇園四条駅から徒歩3分、昼11:00〜14:30 (L.O.13:45)、夜17:00〜22:00 (フードL.O.21:00、ドリンクL.O.21:30)、年中無休。創業 (昭和28年) 以来一頭買いにこだわる精肉店から始まった焼肉店、佐賀牛・宮崎牛・四国三郎牛、オーナー自ら買い付け、手切り、一流ホテル・BARで修行を積んだ料理長、四条河原町を眺望できるお座敷席。メニュー: おすすめ盛り合わせ、厳選牛フィレステーキ、上ロース、上カルビ、上ハラミ、牛タン、褐毛和牛 熊本あか牛、ホルモン、トントロ、肉ケーキ、9種の肉玉手箱コース、ランチ (厳選牛焼肉定食1,300円ほか)。食べログ: 2017年7月12日オープン、34席、カード・PayPay可、禁煙、英語メニュー、2時間制、料金は2026年8月更新。口コミ (2026年、英語): 京都の老舗精肉店まる富の焼肉店、京都と滋賀に精肉店、特選和牛焼肉ランチ3,500円、ご飯おかわり可、夜景の見える窓際の席。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; cards accepted; reservations online.

kyoto_buonagio.gf_detail: Ask. Teppan-grilled steak and seafood, garlic rice, teppan curry, bread and desserts. The shop’s Tabelog profile ticks "gluten-free options" without detail (Tabelog).
kyoto_buonagio.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a steak and seafood teppanyaki house. The Tabelog profile ticks "vegetarian options" without detail — ask (Tabelog).
kyoto_buonagio.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–16:00 (last entry 14:30) Friday–Monday and holidays; dinner 17:30–23:00 (last entry 21:00) daily except Wednesday; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations taken (Tabelog; official site). Cards, PayPay, Alipay and WeChat Pay accepted (Tabelog). A service charge is added (official site); 10% extra from 31 Dec to 3 Jan (Tabelog). 20 seats: 10 at the teppan counter, 5 tables for two; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; English, Chinese and Korean menus (Tabelog). Preschool children may be declined; under-10s seated at tables (official site). On the 2nd floor of GOOD NATURE STATION, next to Takashimaya, 2 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_buonagio.notes: [Teppanyaki · Shijo Kawaramachi, Kobe beef at a relaxed counter] A small teppan steak house, formerly on Dotonbori in Osaka, now on the 2nd floor of GOOD NATURE STATION by Takashimaya. Kobe beef and kuroge wagyu are grilled and flambéed across the counter, with live abalone and lobster. Lunch sets from about ¥4,000; rare wines by the glass. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: The official site describes a teppanyaki steak house that came from Dotonbori in Osaka, keeping its easy-going service, with the owner chatting across the teppan. Run by 株式会社ブォナージョ, registered in Sakai, Osaka (National Tax Agency invoice register T4120001210581).
chef_bio.philosophy: Teppanyaki "without the stiffness": no set pairings — each guest finds a match among rare wines kept fresh by a tasting machine (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Kobe beef sirloin and filet steaks on the teppan.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular had the ¥3,980 lunch with a bottle of wine and praised the flambé and the chef’s pacing of each dish.
A July 2025 party walked in when the 1st-floor restaurant was full and found the owner very kind.
An April 2026 shopper sized the wagyu loin lunch up to 120g and ate it with just wasabi.

cultural_comfort.note: English, Chinese and Korean menus; cards accepted.

kyoto_kissa_giraffe.vegan_detail: Not vegan: custard pudding with cream, omurice, butter toast (reviews).
kyoto_kissa_giraffe.hours_raw: 10:00–20:00 (last order 19:00, last entry 19:00); closed Tuesday; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations. Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). One-drink minimum when ordering food (Tabelog; July 2026). Smoking allowed inside (several 2024–2026 reviews). Often full (2026 reviews). On the 2nd floor of the Main Building, northwest of the Shijo Kawaramachi crossing, about 90 m from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; February 2024).
kyoto_kissa_giraffe.notes: [Kissaten · Shijo Kawaramachi, firm pudding and Napolitan] A retro coffee shop up a flight of stairs just off the Shijo Kawaramachi crossing, opened in 2020 and busy with young regulars. Come for the firm old-style pudding (¥600) and creamy Napolitan (¥900), or thick an-butter toast. Smoking allowed; cash only; one drink each with food. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers (2024–2026) describe a second-floor kissaten opened in 2020 with an old-fashioned look and a young crowd; smoking is allowed.
chef_bio.specialty: Firm custard pudding and Napolitan spaghetti.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 visitor sat at the counter while the owner chatted with regulars, who waved goodbye on leaving.
A September 2026 guest called it possibly the best retro pudding ever eaten.
An August 2026 first-timer was struck by the thickness of the toast at the next table.

kyoto_izakaya_shizuka_yanagikoji.gf_detail: Ask. Dashimaki omelette, simmered home-style dishes, tempura, kushikatsu and fried tofu; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_izakaya_shizuka_yanagikoji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashimaki, nikujaga, dried fish, shishamo nanban-zuke (reviews). Pickled napa cabbage and okara are on the menu — ask (reviews).
kyoto_izakaya_shizuka_yanagikoji.hours_raw: 17:30–22:00 Thursday–Sunday; closed Monday–Wednesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations taken; often full (Tabelog; November 2024). Cash only — no cards or e-money (Tabelog). Counter, tables and tatami seating over two floors; walls (even the restroom) covered in guests’ graffiti (2024–2026 reviews). Drinks are simple: bottled beer, sake in small or large flasks, chuhai, lemon highball (2025 reviews). On Yanagikoji alley between Shinkyogoku and Kawaramachi, 3 min from Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_izakaya_shizuka_yanagikoji.notes: [Izakaya · Yanagikoji, a Taisho-era tavern with graffiti walls] An izakaya on Yanagikoji alley said to date from the early Taisho era, behind a forbidding front; inside it feels like a film set, every wall scrawled with guests' messages. Come for the thick, dashi-rich dashimaki (about ¥500), nikujaga and simmered potatoes with a flask of sake — dinner for about ¥2,000. Cash only; Thursday–Sunday evenings.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers (2024–2026) describe a tavern founded in the early Taisho era, now with a new noren but an unchanged interior, its walls covered with graffiti left by guests; a November 2024 visitor found it run by the owner with the owner’s daughter and an older staff member.

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 visitor had heard that the poet Nakahara Chuya and Hasegawa Yasuko drank here in the Taisho era, and came looking for traces among the graffiti.
A December 2025 solo drinker circled the entrance several times before going in, then was greeted with a cheerful "good evening".
A September 2026 party of five had the dashimaki cut into five portions.

kyoto_gion_shishishi.notes: [Japanese · Tominaga-cho, Gion, a Kikunoi-trained chef till late] A small L-counter in the heart of Gion where a young Kikunoi-trained chef cooks a roughly ¥10,000 six-dish omakase or à la carte — sea bream in chilli oil, grilled gurnard, bottarga soba — with Okayama sake in half pours, and late soba on weekends. ¥2,000 appetizer charge. anecdotes.text: August 2024: "Unlike many spots in Gion that close by 8 or 9 PM, this place stays open later."
May 2025: "when we expressed interest in some of the ingredients on display, he creatively prepared dishes for us."

kyoto_hanasaki_nishiki.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tempura, sushi with soy, ankake and saikyo-miso dishes in the courses (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_hanasaki_nishiki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish-led kaiseki with dashi; Kyoto beef, hamo and crab courses (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_hanasaki_nishiki.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:30–15:00 (food last order 13:30) and 17:30–22:00 (food last order 20:00); closing days not fixed. Reservations taken; private rooms from ¥6,000 at lunch and ¥10,000 at dinner — book early. Service charge 10% — Tabelog, Japanese original 「サービス料10％」. 40 seats with tatami and sunken seating; private rooms for 2–30. Designated smoking area. Cards and PayPay; no e-money. One of four 花咲 shops in Kyoto, including a 祇園本店 and a Miyakawa-cho shop (web listings; November 2025 and November 2026 reviews).
kyoto_hanasaki_nishiki.notes: [Kyoto kaiseki · Sakaimachi by Nishiki Market, private rooms at fair prices] A quiet kaiseki house in an old kimono shop down a passage off Nishiki, with private tatami rooms and a ladder of courses from a ¥2,200 weekday bento to hamo and winter fugu feasts. 10% service. One April 2026 diner found the staff unsmiling and the food dull; most praise the value.

chef_bio.background: Part of the 花咲 group, which has four shops in Kyoto including the Gion main shop (web listings); reviewers in 2025–2026 also mention a Miyakawa-cho branch. Reviewers praise the value, the private rooms and the hamo courses; criticism: unfriendly staff and "quite dull" flavours, including a shrimp tempura wrapped in mochi-like batter and a pickle sushi that "wasn't tasty at all" (April 2026), a slow middle of the lunch course (December 2025), and pricier drinks (November 2025; November 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto kaiseki courses; hamo in summer.

anecdotes.text: February 2026: "We booked the recommended Kashiwagi Course… all for JPY 3,850, which is a great deal considering the location! The restaurant is a renovated kimono shop."

kyoto_tanaka_coffee_gion.notes: [Kissaten · Gion, siphon coffee to 1 am] A Showa-era coffee house under a retro neon sign in Gion's geisha district, one of a small local family of cafés running for over 40 years: siphon coffee, flannel-drip iced coffee, an artful carved fruit platter, parfaits and coffee jelly, open until 1:00 for people who work in Gion. chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a coffee shop in Sueyoshi-cho, Gion. An October 2025 review describes Tanaka Coffee as a local chain of cafés in Kyoto running for over 40 years, and this branch as a long-loved retro café open late for people working in Gion.

kyoto_maika_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Korean home cooking — samgyetang, kimchi, namul — but also chijimi and kimbap (2018–26 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_maika_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: samgyetang, marinated crab, offal hot pot, braised pork (2020–25 reviews).
kyoto_maika_gion.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 18:00–2:00; closed Sunday and holidays; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and needed — samgyetang must be booked ahead, and tables are hard to get (Tabelog; October 2025; January 2026). Cards accepted; no QR (Tabelog). About three tables and a counter (October 2025). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). In Tominaga-cho, 2–3 min from Gion-Shijo (Tabelog; August 2025).
kyoto_maika_gion.notes: [Korean home cooking · Gion, open to 2 am] A tiny, much-booked Korean restaurant in Gion, everything homemade: a samgyetang hot pot (book it ahead) finished with ramen, soy- and chilli-marinated crab, fluffy chive chijimi, kimchi, namul and offal hot pot, with makgeolli. Reserve well in advance; smoking allowed; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a Korean izakaya in Tominaga-cho, Gion. Reviews from 2018 to 2026 describe authentic, homemade Korean dishes and a small room that is hard to book.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 party of five booked two samgyetang ahead and finished with ramen in the broth.
A January 2026 group had been trying to book since the year before and called it the best chijimi anywhere.
A March 2020 diner praised the marinated crab, cut so it is easy to eat.

kyoto_kaenzan.gf_detail: Ask. Spiced and honey-glazed skewers, bread skewers, noodles and fried rice; no gluten information is published (Tabelog menu; reviews).
kyoto_kaenzan.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a lamb and meat skewer house. Vegetable skewers (eggplant, potato, green pepper) are on the menu — ask (Tabelog menu).
kyoto_kaenzan.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 17:00–23:00; Saturday, Sunday and holidays 14:00–23:00; closing days may vary (Tabelog). Reservations taken. Cards, e-money and QR payments accepted (Tabelog). 50 seats with private rooms and tatami; non-smoking, smoking area on the terrace (Tabelog). Each table has a charcoal grill that turns the skewers automatically; diners set the skewers on (2024–2026 reviews). Most skewers are ordered in fives (Tabelog menu). Some staff speak limited Japanese and part of the menu is in Chinese (2024–2025 reviews). On the 3rd floor of Sakura Terrace on Nishikiyamachi, 1 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_kaenzan.notes: [Chinese skewers · Nishikiyamachi, lamb on turning charcoal grills] A big third-floor room where each table has a charcoal grill that slowly turns the skewers for you. Lamb from ¥200 a stick with cumin, plus beef, offal, silkworm pupae and bread, and Yanbian cold noodles to finish. Many Chinese guests; open from 14:00 at weekends.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers (2024–2026) describe a lamb-skewer restaurant with automatic rotating charcoal grills, run by Chinese staff and popular with Chinese guests; an August 2025 visitor thought it was run by the Korean-Chinese community. The menu mixes Chinese skewers with Korean-Chinese dishes such as Yanbian cold noodles (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Lamb skewers on rotating charcoal grills.

anecdotes.text: An October 2024 visitor only worked out the gear in front of the coals when the skewers began to turn, and found it addictive to watch.
A December 2025 guest found the skewers almost the same as ones eaten in Shanghai.
A May 2026 regular, on a fourth or fifth visit, says children love watching the skewers spin.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 火焱山 (KAENZAN)、串焼き・居酒屋、京都市下京区船頭町237-9 サクラテラス3F、阪急河原町駅から徒歩1分、月〜金 17:00〜23:00、土日祝 14:00〜23:00、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、50席、個室あり、禁煙 (テラスに喫煙所)、2024年6月2日オープン。メニュー (2026年1月更新): 羊肉串200円 (5本から)、辛い羊肉串・蜂蜜羊肉串220円、牛すじ串200円、和牛串320円、蚕のさなぎ200円、パン串160円、延辺冷麺900円、刀削麺1,100円、海鮮チヂミ980円、酢豚1,420円。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): テーブルごとに自動で回る炭火の串焼き器、卓上にクミン、メニューの一部は中国語、日本語を話すスタッフは少ない、中国からの客が多い、上海の串焼きと同じ味、鴨の血、豚の皮、甘い白い蒸しパン、子どもも楽しめる。

cultural_comfort.note: Cards accepted; some staff speak limited Japanese; part of the menu in Chinese.

kyoto_amami_keihan_komoto.gf_detail: Ask. Keihan is rice with chicken broth poured over, topped with soy-pickled papaya and shiitake; tempura, cutlets and kara-age are also served; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_amami_keihan_komoto.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken-broth keihan, fish and beef (Tabelog).
kyoto_amami_keihan_komoto.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30, dinner 17:30–21:30, Tuesday–Sunday; closed Monday (open on a holiday Monday, then closed Tuesday) (Tabelog). Reservations taken; same-day course bookings accepted (Tabelog). Cards accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). A la carte: ¥600 seat charge with an appetizer; one drink per person (Tabelog menu). 26 seats: 6 at the 1st-floor counter, tables and sunken horigotatsu rooms upstairs; non-smoking (Tabelog). Down a narrow entrance in an alley off Shinkyogoku, 1 min from Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_amami_keihan_komoto.notes: [Amami chicken rice · off Shinkyogoku, keihan and Kyoto fish] A small two-storey restaurant in an alley by Shinkyogoku serving keihan, the Amami Island dish of rice under hot chicken broth with egg, chicken and pickled papaya (about ¥1,200 at lunch). The chef of 28 years adds thick-cut Kyoto fish sashimi and Tamba beef; tatami rooms upstairs. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: The shop’s Tabelog profile says the evening dishes are cooked by a chef with 28 years of experience, and pairs Amami Island cooking with Kyoto ingredients: Tamba black chicken for the keihan broth, Kyoto rice and local fish, served on Shigaraki ware.
chef_bio.specialty: Amami keihan (chicken rice) with Tamba black-chicken broth.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 couple wandered in from the shopping street and found keihan like chirashi with chicken broth poured over it.
A July 2026 business traveller took a team for the all-you-can-drink course and called it a steal for sashimi, sushi, chicken and ochazuke.
A September 2026 diner had seen keihan on TV and never expected to find it in Kyoto.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京都ご飯 奄美の鶏飯 小元、居酒屋・日本料理・海鮮、京都市中京区中之町565-6、河原町駅から徒歩1分、火〜日 11:30〜14:30・17:30〜21:30、月曜定休 (祝日の場合は翌火曜)、予約可、カード可、26席 (1階カウンター6席、2階テーブル・掘りごたつ)、禁煙、信楽焼の器、料理歴28年の料理人、丹波黒どりの出汁の鶏飯。メニュー (2024年): 鶏飯1,200円 (昼)・1,400円 (夜)、京の天然魚のお造り1,850円、丹波黒どりの唐揚げ1,350円、油そうめん、豚みそ、ランチのセット (天然魚2,000円、天ぷら1,850円、丹波牛ステーキ3,500円)、アラカルトはお通し付きチャージ600円、ワンドリンク制。口コミ (2026年、英語): 新京極の路地の奥、鶏飯は錦糸卵、裂いた鶏、椎茸、パパイヤの醤油漬けに出汁をかける、厚切りのお造り、鱧の天ぷら、日替わりを鶏飯に変えて2,100円、2階の掘りごたつ、丁寧な接客。

cultural_comfort.note: Cards accepted; tatami and counter seats.

kyoto_monakado.gf_detail: Ask. A long izakaya menu of fried dishes, tempura, gratins, nama-fu and yuba; no gluten information is published (Tabelog menu; reviews).
kyoto_monakado.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an izakaya of fish, meat and cheese dishes. Simple vegetable plates (edamame, cucumber with miso, grilled manganji peppers) are listed — ask (Tabelog menu).
kyoto_monakado.hours_raw: 17:00–24:00 daily (food last order 23:00, drinks 23:30); closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Reservations taken; 2-hour limit Friday–Sunday, holiday eves and peak seasons (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR accepted; no seat charge (Tabelog). 33 seats: 7 at the counter, 26 at tables; fully non-smoking (Tabelog). Busy, often full at weekends and popular as a second stop (2026 reviews). On the 2nd floor on Kawaramachi-dori north of Shijo, 3 min from Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_monakado.notes: [Izakaya · Kawaramachi, a long menu and open till midnight] A busy wood-panelled izakaya up on a second floor on Kawaramachi-dori, open till midnight every day. The menu runs long — avocado gratin, nama-fu and yuba gratin, chicken nanban, corn and ginger tempura — at small-plate prices. Good for a second stop; book at weekends.

chef_bio.background: Opened in June 2009 (Tabelog); run by 株式会社阪林 of Kamigyo, Kyoto (National Tax Agency invoice register T4130001064820). The shop calls itself a creative-cuisine izakaya with vegetable obanzai and time-honoured recipes, popular with office workers.
chef_bio.specialty: Avocado gratin; a long menu of small plates.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 regular on a fifth visit still had many dishes left to try.
A September 2026 guest arrived at 17:00 on a holiday eve; by 17:30 the room was full.
An August 2026 diner found the ¥3,800 course so generous the kara-age was hard to finish.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: もなか堂、居酒屋・創作料理・焼酎バー、京都市中京区河原町通四条上ル米屋町378 2F、阪急河原町駅から徒歩3分、毎日17:00〜24:00 (L.O.フード23:00、ドリンク23:30)、不定休、予約可、金土日祝・祝前日などは2時間制、カード・電子マネー・QR可、チャージ料なし、33席 (カウンター7、テーブル26)、全面禁煙、2009年6月3日オープン、インボイス T4130001064820 (株式会社阪林)。メニュー (2024年): アボカドのグラタン620円、和風アヒージョ750円、トマトキムチ450円、揚げ出し茄子520円、とうもろこしの天ぷら550円、賀茂茄子の田楽650円、飲み放題付きコース4,000円・4,500円。口コミ (2026年、英語): メニューが多い、チキン南蛮、生麩と湯葉のグラタン、生姜の天ぷら、水茄子の生ハム巻き、二軒目に人気、週末は満席、手頃な値段。

cultural_comfort.note: Cards accepted; book at weekends.

kyoto_hanzan_nishikiyamachi.gf_detail: Ask. Grilled aged pork with ssamjang, marinated bulgogi, kimchi, kimbap and stews; no gluten information is published (Tabelog menu; reviews).
kyoto_hanzan_nishikiyamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Korean pork barbecue restaurant (Tabelog).
kyoto_hanzan_nishikiyamachi.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 daily (food last order 22:00, drinks and desserts 22:30); closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Reservations taken. Cards, e-money and PayPay accepted (Tabelog). 56 seats: tables, some divided by roll screens, and a 6-seat counter; non-smoking; parties up to 40 (Tabelog). Staff grill and cut the samgyeopsal at your table; wrap leaves refilled free (several 2026 reviews). A pig-shaped bench at the door (2026 reviews). On Nishikiyamachi along the Takase River, 1 min north of Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn exit 1A (Tabelog).
kyoto_hanzan_nishikiyamachi.notes: [Korean barbecue · Nishikiyamachi, aged pork grilled for you] A bright Korean dining bar on Nishikiyamachi, its door marked by a pig-shaped bench. The pork is aged 240 hours, and staff grill and cut the samgyeopsal at your table (150g ¥890), with free refills of lettuce and basil for wrapping. Makgeolli and soju to drink; open daily till 23:00.

chef_bio.background: Opened in July 2021 (Tabelog). The shop says it ages Japanese pork for 240 hours with its own method and calls its aged samgyeopsal a Kyoto first (Tabelog). The invoice holder is 株式会社晃商 of Higashiyama, Kyoto (National Tax Agency register T2130001080605).
chef_bio.specialty: Aged-pork samgyeopsal, grilled at the table by staff.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 guest was told the plum soy dipping sauce comes from the owner’s Korean mother.
A June 2026 regular marked the restaurant’s fifth anniversary with another samgyeopsal dinner.
An August 2026 visitor, back from Busan, found it tasted better than in Korea and less fiery.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ハンザン、韓国料理・ダイニングバー、京都市中京区高瀬川筋四条上る紙屋町672 永原ビル1F、阪急京都河原町駅1A出口から西木屋町通を北へ徒歩1分、毎日17:00〜23:00 (L.O.フード22:00、ドリンク・デザート22:30)、不定休、予約可、カード・電子マネー・PayPay可、56席、禁煙、2021年7月1日オープン、インボイス T2130001080605 (株式会社晃商)。メニュー (2026年7月): 独自の方法で240時間熟成させた国産豚の「京都初」熟成サムギョプサル150g 890円、熟成モクサル890円、牛プルコギ100g 890円、ユッケ1,690円、チョレギサラダ690円、とびこと海鮮チャンジャのキンパ990円、白菜キムチ490円、マッコリ、チャミスル、テラビール、コース3,000円、飲み放題2,000円。口コミ (2026年、英語): スタッフがテーブルで焼いて切ってくれる、包み野菜はおかわり自由、入口に豚のベンチ、オーナーの韓国人の母の梅醤油だれ、5周年、ヤンニョムチキン、スンドゥブ、韓国産味噌のテンジャンチゲ。

cultural_comfort.note: Cards accepted; staff grill the meat for you.

kyoto_taishu_sakaba_memory.gf_detail: Not GF: soft-bone karaage, fries, grilled chikuwa and stews with soy (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_taishu_sakaba_memory.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish and offal tavern (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_taishu_sakaba_memory.hours_raw: Monday–Thursday 14:00–23:00 (last orders food 22:30, drinks 22:45); Friday–Saturday 14:00–24:00 (last orders 23:30 and 23:45); closed Sunday; banquets outside hours by arrangement (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 41 seats; non-smoking; ordering by phone QR (Tabelog; April 2026). Near Nishiki Market, between Teramachi and Karasuma; 5 min walk from Shijo or Hankyu Karasuma Stn (Tabelog; February 2025). Opened 31 July 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_taishu_sakaba_memory.notes: [Tavern · by Nishiki Market, from 2 p.m.] A friendly, cheap tavern a step from Nishiki Market, open from mid-afternoon: a ¥1,000 senbero set of a drink and two small plates, all-you-can-drink from 30 minutes, and favourites like aji heaped with green onion, meat tofu and soft-bone karaage. Order by phone; food can be slow when busy. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a tavern of 41 seats opened 31 July 2023 near Nishiki Market. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe cheerful staff, low prices and many regulars.
chef_bio.specialty: Senbero set; aji with green onion.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 visitor was told the side dish of beans is free from the second visit, and enjoyed plenty.
A December 2025 diner found a table here when everywhere else was full at year end; the food took a while but was good.
An October 2026 regular orders the ¥1,000 senbero set every time, choosing the stew and ume kombu.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・海鮮・ホルモン、中京区八百屋町538-1、地下鉄四条駅・阪急烏丸駅から徒歩5分、月〜木 14:00〜23:00 (L.O.フード22:30、ドリンク22:45)、金・土 14:00〜24:00 (L.O.23:30・23:45)、日曜休み、時間外の宴会は相談可、予約可、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners)・PayPay 可、電子マネー不可、41席、禁煙、2023年7月31日開店。口コミ (2025年2月〜2026年11月、英語): 錦市場の近く、昼から飲める、1,000円のせんべろセット、30分からの飲み放題、ねぎたっぷりの鯵、肉豆腐、たことサーモンのマリネ、ガツポン、なんこつ唐揚げ、煮込み、焼きちくわ、梅昆布、フライドポテト、2回目からお豆のつまみが無料、スマホで注文、明るい店員、混むと料理が遅いとの声 (2025年12月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Phone ordering; cheap sets; cards and PayPay.

kyoto_odashi_nihonshu_setsu.gf_detail: Ask. Dashi-led cooking — oden, dashimaki, simmered fish, sashimi, grilled fish — but also tempura; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_odashi_nihonshu_setsu.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based oden and fish dishes (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_odashi_nihonshu_setsu.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–14:00 and 18:00–23:30 (last order 23:00); irregular closing days (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). A charge of ¥600 incl. tax for seat-only bookings, none with a course (Tabelog original 600円(税込)※席のみ予約時のため、コース予約ではお取りしません。). Cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 30 seats; non-smoking at lunch, a designated smoking area otherwise (Tabelog). Can be run by one person at lunch (February 2026). Hidden in a narrow alley off Yanaginobanba north of Nishiki Market, its name not visible from the street; 5 min walk from Hankyu Karasuma Stn (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 1 May 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_odashi_nihonshu_setsu.notes: [Dashi izakaya · Yanaginobanba off Nishiki, alley] A hidden alley izakaya devoted to dashi and sake: good-value lunch sets — beef tendon and daikon, miso-grilled salmon, simmered flounder — and at night oden, dashimaki, sashimi and seasonal fish dishes. Hard to find from the street. ¥600 charge for seat-only bookings at night.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an izakaya of oden and kamameshi, opened 1 May 2023, with a website at odashitonihonshusetsu.com. A February 2026 lunch guest found one person doing both cooking and serving.
chef_bio.specialty: Oden; beef tendon and daikon set.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 weekday lunch guest had the miso-marinated silver salmon set for ¥1,200, served quickly though one person was cooking and serving.
An October 2026 visitor noted the shop name cannot be seen from Yanaginobanba, making it hard to find alone.
A September 2026 diner liked the dashi in the oden and omelette but found the room short-staffed.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・おでん・釜飯、中京区井筒屋町421、阪急烏丸駅から徒歩5分、毎日 12:00〜14:00、18:00〜23:30 (L.O.23:00)、不定休、予約可、席のみ予約は600円 (税込、コース予約ではかからない)、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、30席、昼は全席禁煙、分煙、2023年5月1日開店、公式サイトあり。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年10月、英語): 柳馬場から入った細い路地の奥、店名が通りから見えない、昼の定食 (牛すじ大根1,350円、銀鮭の西京焼き1,200円、かれいの煮付け1,200円、豚タンのねぎ塩)、夜はだしの効いたおでん、だし巻き、刺身、かつおのたたき、さんまのカルパッチョ、天ぷら、豆腐サラダ、飲み放題あり・なしのコース、昼は1人で営業していたとの声、店員が少ないとの声 (2026年9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Hidden alley; ¥600 seat-only charge at night; cards, IC and PayPay.

kyoto_fumiya_nishiki.gf_detail: Not GF: wheat udon, shrimp and chicken tempura (2026 reviews).
kyoto_fumiya_nishiki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi broth, egg, shrimp and chicken (2026 reviews).
kyoto_fumiya_nishiki.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–17:30; closed 1–2 January; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations; queues at lunch from about 11:00, quieter mid-afternoon (Tabelog; July–September 2026). Cards (JCB, AMEX), e-money and QR; non-smoking (Tabelog). Counter seating (Tabelog). In Nishiki Market west of Sakaimachi (Tabelog). The company's main shop was temporarily closed in July 2026 (July 2026 review).
kyoto_fumiya_nishiki.notes: [Udon · Nishiki Market] A long-established Nishiki udon house serving soft Kyoto-style noodles in gentle dashi: the signature Fumiya nabe of shrimp tempura, shiitake, egg and mochi bubbling in its pot, tori-ten ankake udon and curry udon, with two house shichimi to finish. Queues at lunch; go mid-afternoon. Daytime only.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: 冨美家, trading in Nishiki Market for more than 80 years, makes Kyoto udon with dashi and soft noodles, and sells its Fumiya nabe and other products; the site names a Nishiki shop and a main shop. A July 2026 reviewer found the main shop temporarily closed.
chef_bio.philosophy: Dashi-focused Kyoto udon with soft noodles (official site).

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 regular, finding the main shop still closed, came to Nishiki for the tori-ten ankake udon (¥990) and tried both house shichimi.
A July 2026 visitor noted lines from around 11:00 at lunch.
A May 2026 regular comes alone for the Fumiya nabe, as the reviewer’s husband rarely goes to udon places.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: うどん、中京区錦小路通堺町西入中魚屋町493、毎日 11:00〜17:30、1月1・2日休み、営業時間は変わることあり、予約不可、カード (JCB・AMEX)・電子マネー・QR 可、禁煙、カウンター。公式サイト: 錦市場で80年以上、だしとやわらかい麺の京うどん、冨美家鍋、錦店と本店。口コミ (2026年5月〜9月、英語): やさしいだし、細くやわらかい京うどん、名物の冨美家鍋 (海老天、椎茸の含め煮、卵、ねぎ、餅)、海老天鍋焼きうどん1,320円、鶏天付きのセット1,760円、丹波鶏の鍋焼き、鶏天あんかけうどん990円、たぬき、カレーうどん、小丼のセット、赤 (青のり) と黒のオリジナル七味、昼は11時ごろから行列、午後は入りやすい、本店は休業中との声 (2026年7月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter udon shop; queues at lunch; cards, IC and QR.

kyoto_saigon_saigon_ryoma.gf_detail: Ask. Rice-noodle pho and rice plates, but also fried spring rolls, shrimp wrapped in fried noodles and sauces of unknown make-up (2026 reviews).
kyoto_saigon_saigon_ryoma.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken, beef and seafood pho, pork and shrimp dishes (2026 reviews).
kyoto_saigon_saigon_ryoma.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); closed Mondays — open on a Monday holiday and closed the next Tuesday instead (Tabelog). Bookings taken; private hire by phone (Tabelog). Cards and QR (PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay); no e-money (Tabelog). 47 seats over two floors; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children welcome (Tabelog). 6 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi (Tabelog), near Nishiki Market (May 2026 review).
kyoto_saigon_saigon_ryoma.notes: [Vietnamese · Nishiki] A machiya off Nishiki Market hung with Vietnamese lanterns, serving pho and multi-dish lunch sets by day and a Vietnamese izakaya menu at night. Lunch about ¥1,000–1,500; dinner about ¥4,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 17 June 2022 (Tabelog). A converted Kyoto townhouse decorated with Vietnamese lanterns (October 2026 review; macaro-ni). An October 2026 diner understood the chef to be Vietnamese; a July 2026 diner described the staff as Vietnamese.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 diner came for dinner after a morning at the Kyoto International Manga Museum and found every dish reasonably good but the seasoning short of sharp.
A diner who had booked a birthday lunch in August 2026 was seated at the counter despite the reservation.
A July 2026 diner stopped in at 7:13 pm for a second dinner of beef pho at ¥935.
An October 2026 diner ordered salt-seared bonito, Da Nang grilled squid and shrimp wrapped in fried Hong Kong noodles, and noted Dalat wine by the bottle at about ¥4,000.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Saigon★Saigon 龍馬、ベトナム料理、中京区伊勢屋町345、阪急河原町駅から徒歩6分、火〜日 11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:30)・17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、月曜休み (祝日の場合は営業し翌火曜休み)、予約可、カードと QR 決済可、電子マネー不可、47席 (1階19席、2階28席)、禁煙、車いす可、子ども可、2022年6月17日オープン。macaro-ni: 京都河原町駅から徒歩7分、2022年6月オープン、ベトナムと京都が融合した空間とランタン、定番の「Saigonランチ」は6種類から選べ、青パパイヤのサラダ、カインチュア、デザート付きで1,430円 (記事の日付不明)。口コミ (2026年5月〜10月、英語): Saigon lunch 1,540円、海鮮の辛いフォーのランチ 1,260円、Com Am Phu のセット 1,150円、牛肉のフォー 935円、生春巻き・揚げ春巻き・蒸し春巻き、Da Nang の焼きイカ、ベトナム人のスタッフ。

cultural_comfort.note: Casual; Vietnamese staff (July 2026 review).

kyoto_utsurigi_shokudo.gf_detail: Ask. Much of the menu is wheat — handmade pasta, ramen, dandan noodles, dumplings — but there are meat, fish and vegetable plates too (2018–2025 reviews).
kyoto_utsurigi_shokudo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken-and-clam ramen, gizzard ajillo, roast beef, mapo tofu (2018–2025 reviews).
kyoto_utsurigi_shokudo.hours_raw: Tue–Sat 17:30–26:00, Sun 17:30–22:00; last order 30 min before closing; closed Mondays (Tabelog). Bookings taken; counter or table by availability; a two-hour limit may apply (Tabelog). Cards and Rakuten Pay; no e-money (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog Japanese original 「なし」). 9 seats; all non-smoking from January 2026 (Tabelog). 1 min from Gion-Shijo Stn exit 9 (Tabelog).
kyoto_utsurigi_shokudo.notes: [Italian & Chinese · Gion] A nine-seat counter-and-table eatery on Nawate run by one cook, mixing Italian and Chinese plates — white dandan noodles, clam ramen, ajillo, dumplings — with a shelf of homemade fruit liqueurs. Open to 2 am most nights. About ¥3,000–5,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 15 December 2017 (Tabelog). The owner, named as Sugiyama on Tabelog, became a cook out of a love of good food (Tabelog). Trained in Japanese, Italian and Chinese cooking (December 2025 review) and runs the place alone (June 2025 review). The white dandan noodles have been on television several times (Tabelog); a June 2025 diner came after seeing the shop on a Kansai TV programme.
chef_bio.philosophy: Hopes guests will enjoy trying many different dishes (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: White dandan noodles; homemade fruit liqueurs.

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 diner came after a night of bar-hopping for the chicken-salt clam ramen seen on TV: a clear broth with clams at the bottom and thin, straight, almost pasta-like noodles.
A regular on a June 2018 omakase dinner learned that the black pepper on the fried dishes came from a Gion spice shop, and went to buy some the next day.
An October 2024 diner rated the gizzard and green-onion ajillo the best dish and planned to come back for the Sichuan mapo tofu and dandan noodles.
A December 2025 diner found so many food and drink options it was hard to choose, including homemade fruit syrups served with or without alcohol.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: うつりぎ食堂、イタリアン・バル・ラーメン、東山区縄手通り三条下ル弁財天町12 祇園シャトービル 1A、祇園四条駅9番出口から徒歩1分、火〜土 17:30〜26:00、日 17:30〜22:00 (L.O. は閉店30分前)、月曜休み、予約可 (2時間制の場合あり)、カードと楽天ペイ可、サービス料「なし」、9席、2026年1月から全席禁煙、2017年12月15日オープン。店主 (Sugiyama) は中華とイタリアンを基にした料理を出し、白担々麺はテレビで何度も紹介 (食べログの紹介文、英訳)。口コミ (2018〜2025年、英語): 一人で切り盛り (2025年6月)、和食・イタリアン・中華で修業 (2025年12月)、鶏塩のあさりラーメン、自家製の果実酒、砂肝とねぎのアヒージョ、水餃子、麻婆豆腐。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter run by one cook; friendly owner (2023–2025 reviews).

existence.note: Tabelog listing (no-smoking change from January 2026); reviews dated through December 2025.

kyoto_nitchian_kawaramachi.gf_detail: Ask. Salt yakitori is possible, but tare, izakaya side dishes and the set appetizer are unknown (2016–2026 reviews).
kyoto_nitchian_kawaramachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken yakitori, seafood and grilled izakaya dishes (2016–2026 reviews).
kyoto_nitchian_kawaramachi.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 17:00–23:00; closed Mondays; hours may change (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards or e-money (Tabelog). 26 seats: 8 at the counter, three tables of four, 6 on tatami (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog; April 2026 review). 5 min from Keihan Sanjo (Tabelog).
kyoto_nitchian_kawaramachi.notes: [Yakitori & sake · Kawaramachi] A long-running, smoky little izakaya with a counter in front of the charcoal grill, local regulars, a wide sake list and izakaya dishes beyond the skewers. Cash only; smoking allowed. About ¥3,000–5,000.

chef_bio.background: Reviewed on Tabelog since 2014. The master cooked alone on a busy December 2019 night (December 2019 review); an April 2025 diner calls the owner "Acchan". The owner chooses sake and daily specials for guests who ask (December 2016 review).

anecdotes.text: On the July 2022 Gion Matsuri eve, with the streets packed, a diner got the end seat at the counter in front of the grill, had liver, tsukune, thigh and gizzard grilled one by one, drank Toyo Bijin junmai ginjo by the 90 cc half-go, and left early because of the smoke from the next table.
A December 2016 pair left the sake and the order to the owner — beef and chicken tataki, buttered oysters and a yakitori platter — and noted many solo regulars, including women dining alone.
On a third visit in April 2025, a diner chatted with the local regulars at the counter and found owner "Acchan" kind; the fruit chuhai tasted unlike any other.
An April 2026 diner advised ordering early because dishes take time, and warned non-smokers about the small, smoking room.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日知庵、串焼き・焼き鳥・居酒屋、中京区河原町六角あじびる北東入ル 河原町ビル1F、京阪三条駅から徒歩5分、火〜日 17:00〜23:00、月曜休み (変更の可能性あり)、予約可、カード・電子マネー不可、26席 (カウンター8、4人テーブル3、座敷6)、喫煙可、日本酒・焼酎にこだわり。口コミ (2014〜2026年、英語): 炭火で一本ずつ焼く焼き鳥、イカの串焼き、アスパラ、日本酒が豊富 (Toyo Bijin の純米吟醸を半合90cc で、2022年7月)、店主おまかせ (2016年12月)、一人で調理 (2019年12月)、店主 "Acchan" (2025年4月)、料理は時間がかかり喫煙可 (2026年4月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Regulars' counter; cash only; smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through April 2026. The Tabelog website link (a-dos.ne.jp) did not load on 2026-11-07.

kyoto_miyagawacho_tensho.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a tempura course in wheat batter, with a kakiage rice bowl or tendon to finish (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_miyagawacho_tensho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: prawn, fish and eel tempura, sashimi and dashi (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_miyagawacho_tensho.hours_raw: Dinner Mon, Wed, Fri and holidays 17:30–22:00; Tue, Thu, Sat 18:00–22:00; last entry 19:00; closed Sundays and two Mondays a month (Tabelog). Lunch Tue, Thu, Sat from 11:30, eight servings (February 2026 review). Reservation only; tell the restaurant about allergies in advance (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 10 counter seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). 7 min from Gion-Shijo Stn, on the Miyagawa-suji (Tabelog; February 2026 review).
kyoto_miyagawacho_tensho.notes: [Tempura · Miyagawacho] A ten-seat tempura counter on the Miyagawa-suji, opened in 2024 by a chef from Tempura Yoshikawa: light, seasonal tempura courses with sashimi and soup, and a rare good-value lunch three days a week. Dinner about ¥20,000–30,000; lunch ¥4,950. Booking only.

chef_bio.background: Opened 29 May 2024 (Tabelog) by chef Hasegawa, who spent 21 years at Kyo-Tomikoji Tempura Yoshikawa, 18 of them as head chef (February 2026 review). A February 2026 diner had heard it was a Michelin Guide Selected restaurant for 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: White soybean oil for a light batter; seafood and produce chosen by the owner (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: An April 2025 diner swapped the tendon for tencha served with dashi instead of green tea, and singled out the clear soup, the sea bream shirako and the sea bream with sea urchin.

In February 2026 a diner whose daughter had found the ¥4,950 lunch in a magazine found one chef at the counter, a university student serving, and fans of Miyagawacho geiko and maiko on the walls; no oil was left on the napkin.
On a second visit in July 2026 a diner chose the course with à la carte dishes and praised the large hamo and the eel rice to finish.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 宮川町 天匠、天ぷら、東山区宮川筋4-300-5、祇園四条駅から徒歩約7分、月・水・金・祝 17:30〜22:00、火・木・土 18:00〜22:00、最終入店19:00、日曜休み、月2回月曜不定休、予約のみ (アレルギーは事前に)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、カウンター10席、禁煙、2024年5月29日オープン、大豆油100%で揚げる (紹介文、英訳)。口コミ (2025年4月〜2026年7月、英語): 料理長 Hasegawa は Tempura Yoshikawa に21年 (うち料理長18年)、昼のコース 4,950円 (税・サ込み、火・木・土、8食)、夜は18,500円から、Akashi の穴子、Naruto Kintoki、天茶、カレー塩、夏の鱧とうなぎご飯。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter course; booking only; friendly chef (2025–26 reviews).

kyoto_natari_kagiya.gf_detail: Ask. Meat buns, dan dan noodles, fried rice, spring rolls, chicken tempura and kara-age, ponzu and soy-based dishes; no gluten information (Tabelog menu; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_natari_kagiya.vegan_detail: Ask. Mostly meat and fish; a basil salad, a parsley salad and chilled tofu with pickled mustard greens are mentioned without any description of how each is made, and the edamame comes with ago (flying-fish) dashi (2026 reviews).
kyoto_natari_kagiya.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 16:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); closed Sunday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 15 seats: 7 at the counter and 8 at tables (Tabelog). Non-smoking with a designated smoking area (Tabelog). On the second floor of the Kagiya Koji Kaikan, up steep stairs (Tabelog; October 2026); about 7 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi (Tabelog). Opened 24 March 2026 (Tabelog).
kyoto_natari_kagiya.notes: [Izakaya · Fuyacho-Takatsuji, meat buns and Asian small plates] A 15-seat second-floor izakaya in the new Kagiya Koji Kaikan, where the owner mixes Japanese, Chinese and Southeast Asian flavours — a much-praised meat bun, bak kut teh, dan dan noodles, fried rice — with sake by the half serving. Cassette tapes on the shelves; popular, and dishes can sell out by 8 pm. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: A March 2026 reviewer writes that the owner trained at a yakitori restaurant, a seafood restaurant and a Chinese restaurant; a July 2026 reviewer writes that the owner comes from Daihō, a charcoal-grill restaurant. Reviewers describe the owner as kind and warm towards solo diners (July and October 2026).

anecdotes.text: The Kagiya Koji Kaikan is a group of small restaurants joined by a private alleyway; Natari opened in it in March 2026 (April 2026 review).
A July 2026 visitor arriving at 8 pm found about half the menu already sold out, and noted the many cassette tapes collected as a hobby.
An October 2026 solo diner was amused by a sake with a special label for glasses wearers and liked being able to order sake by the half serving.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 名足、居酒屋、下京区鍵屋町219-1 鍵屋小路会館2階、阪急河原町駅から徒歩7分、月〜土 16:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、日曜定休、カード可、15席 (カウンター7、テーブル8)、2026年3月24日オープン、名物の肉まん550円、担々麺1,200円、炒飯1,000円、肉骨茶1,600円、牡蠣オムレツ1,300円、うざく980円。口コミ (2026年、英語): 和・中華・エスニックを合わせた料理、肴3種盛り、ほたるいかのなめろう、鯖のポテトサラダ、あご出汁の枝豆、油揚げイカ納豆、日本酒は半合でも注文できる、カセットテープが並ぶ店内。店主は焼き鳥、海鮮、中華の店で修業 (2026年3月)、炭火焼の店「Daihō」の出身 (2026年7月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter-and-tables izakaya; cards accepted.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (corporate member); reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_sake_to_oryori_tsugu.gf_detail: Ask. Kappo izakaya cooking on dashi — oden, simmered fish, Saikyo-miso grilled fish, tempura and kara-age, kamameshi; no gluten information (Tabelog menu; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_sake_to_oryori_tsugu.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the oden broth is made from grilled sea-bream bones and beef tendon (Tabelog), the operator stresses dashi as the base of its cooking (D-HEART site), and the menu is built on fish and Wagyu.
kyoto_sake_to_oryori_tsugu.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday–Sunday and holidays 17:30–23:30 (L.O. 23:00); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). The operator’s site lists 17:30–1:00 (L.O. 0:00) with irregular closing days — the Tabelog hours are used. Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay (Tabelog). 47 seats: an 11-seat counter on the ground floor and 36 seats in tables, tatami and private rooms upstairs (Tabelog). In a machiya south of Shijo on Sakaimachi, 2 min from exit 26 of Shijo/Karasuma stations (Tabelog). Moved here on 1 March 2026 after about 14 years at the old site (D-HEART site).
kyoto_sake_to_oryori_tsugu.notes: [Kappo izakaya · Shijo Sakaimachi, kamameshi and oden] A calm machiya with an 11-seat counter downstairs and private rooms upstairs, serving seasonal sashimi, oden in a sea-bream-bone broth, kamameshi cooked to order and Ozaki Beef, à la carte or as a course from ¥5,500. Run by D-HEART, which also runs Sou nearby (flagged as a local group). Moved here in March 2026; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: 株式会社D-HEART, which runs several restaurants in Kyoto, says its trained Japanese cooks put dashi first. Its site lists SOU（宗）, 酒とお料理 つぐ and BAR 京もーど; Tsugu moved to this machiya on 1 March 2026 after about 14 years at its earlier site.
chef_bio.philosophy: Dashi as the base of Japanese cooking, drawing out the taste of the ingredients (D-HEART site).

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 regular followed the restaurant to its new site and found the cooking as good as before.
A July 2026 visitor from Tokyo, whose usual bar was closed, came in for the kamameshi and wished the whole place could move to Kagurazaka.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 株式会社D-HEARTのサイト: 京都市内に複数の飲食店を展開、日本料理の基本である出汁にこだわる、SOU（宗）、気軽な割烹居酒屋「酒とお料理 つぐ」(さけとおりょうり つぐ)、BAR 京もーど。つぐは約14年営業した場所から移転し、2026年3月1日に下京区四条堺町下ル小石町120で営業開始。食べログ: 居酒屋、月・火・木〜日・祝 17:30〜23:30 (L.O.23:00)、水曜定休、47席 (1階カウンター11、2階テーブル36)、個室あり、季節のおまかせコース5,500円から、Ozaki Beefのたたき2,500円、焼き鯛のアラと牛すじの出汁のおでん、釜飯、自家製からすみ。口コミ (2026年、英語): ほたるいか、海老芋の唐揚げ、茄子と生麩の揚げ浸し、鱧のフライ柴漬けタルタル。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter or private rooms; cards accepted.

kyoto_torinabe_chin_miyagawacho.gf_detail: Ask. Chicken-broth hot pot finished with ramen, chicken spring rolls with sweet bean sauce, pasta; the lunch ramen uses wheat noodles. No gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_torinabe_chin_miyagawacho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: everything is built on a Hinai-chicken broth simmered for about two days (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_torinabe_chin_miyagawacho.hours_raw: 11:00–24:00 daily (Tabelog). Dinner is a members-only, referral-only chicken hot-pot course at ¥18,000 a head; lunch serves soba and ramen without reservations (Tabelog). One or two groups a day at dinner (2026 reviews). Cards, e-money and QR, including Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 6 seats: 2 at the counter and a table for 4, with private rooms (Tabelog; October 2026). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). In a narrow lane in Miyagawa-cho, 5 min from Keihan Gion-Shijo (Tabelog). Opened 6 April 2026 (Tabelog).
kyoto_torinabe_chin_miyagawacho.notes: [Chicken hot pot · Miyagawa-cho, Hinai jidori] A tiny Miyagawa-cho house where a former Italian chef serves a Hinai-chicken hot-pot course with Italian touches — dinner is referral-only, one or two groups a day, ¥18,000 with drinks. At lunch a three-seat ramen window serves foamed chicken paitan ramen to anyone. Smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe the owner as a young former Italian chef (May and October 2026). The premises hold three parts: Tori Nabe Chin, Take Away Myou and the Ramen Window Yatsugare (June 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: “Eating the broth” — the chicken is used to the last drop (May 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner says the course opens with plain Hinai broth, served without any seasoning.
At the lunch ramen window the broth is whipped into a foam so it clings to the noodles (June 2026).

cultural_comfort.note: Dinner by referral only; lunch ramen is open to all.

kyoto_cafe_kitchen_kurun.gf_detail: Ask. Omurice on bouillon demi-glace rice with ketchup and hashed-beef sauces, and baked spaghetti; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_cafe_kitchen_kurun.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the menu is omurice (egg, butter, hashed beef) and baked spaghetti such as bacon and vegetable (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_cafe_kitchen_kurun.hours_raw: Monday, Thursday–Sunday 11:00–16:00; closed Tuesday and Wednesday; may close early when sold out (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). No cards or e-money; d Barai accepted (Tabelog). 7 counter seats (Tabelog). Second floor, up stairs, a minute from Nishiki market, about 300 m from Karasuma (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Opened 29 October 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_cafe_kitchen_kurun.notes: [Omurice · Sakaimachi by Nishiki, a couple’s seven-seat counter] A tiny second-floor counter a minute from Nishiki market where a couple serves neatly wrapped omurice — ketchup, hashed-beef sauce or both — and baked spaghetti at lunch. One cook does everything, so expect a wait at busy times. No cards; closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe the shop as run by a couple (August 2025, February and August 2026), with the husband cooking everything alone (August 2025).

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 Saturday visitor waited 10 minutes for a seat and 30 more for the food; the staff apologised sincerely, which made the wait easier.
At the end of December 2025 the menu was omurice only.

kyoto_nokuru_takamiya.gf_detail: Ask. An omakase of sashimi, grilled and smoked fish, game meats and tempura with noodles to finish (2024–26 reviews); dislikes can be left out if told in advance (May 2025). No gluten information.
kyoto_nokuru_takamiya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, venison, wild boar and bear in an omakase course (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_nokuru_takamiya.hours_raw: Daily 18:00–2:00 (last order 1:00); closed irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; mainly a single omakase course, with requests possible late at night (Tabelog; May 2025; February 2026). Cards (VISA, Master); no e-money (Tabelog). 10 counter seats (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). A course takes about two and a half hours (February 2026). In Takamiya-cho, 4–5 min from Kawaramachi, Karasuma and Shijo (Tabelog). Opened 7 July 2021 (Tabelog).
kyoto_nokuru_takamiya.notes: [Omakase izakaya · Takamiya-cho, game and own-caught fish] A ten-seat counter between Karasuma and Kawaramachi where chef Fujimura cooks a ¥6,600 omakase of producer-direct fish and vegetables, smoked Biwa trout, sashimi of fish the owner caught, and charcoal-grilled venison, boar or bear hot pot in season, with well-chosen sake. Open to 2:00; book ahead.

chef_bio.chef_name: Fujimura (given name not in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an izakaya opened in July 2021 serving fresh seafood and seasonal vegetables direct from producers, and game such as wild boar and deer grilled over charcoal. A January 2024 review says the owner serves fish caught personally.
chef_bio.philosophy: Simply grilled over charcoal to bring out the flavour of the meat (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase with game and fresh fish.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular calls it the first place to recommend in Kyoto, for chef Fujimura's dishes and sake picks — and wishes it could stay a secret.
A February 2026 diner came for the game and found the long-awaited bear hot pot tender and sweet, over a two-and-a-half-hour course.
An August 2026 diner enjoyed the smoked Biwa trout served with the smoke trapped under its cover.

kyoto_yoru_no_tobari.notes: [Creative izakaya · Kiyamachi Rokkaku, obanzai and duck] A dim, stylish second-floor izakaya down a Kiyamachi alley, opened in 2024: a colourful obanzai platter of Kyoto vegetables, duck, eel and edamame rice, a deep-fried dashimaki, and Kyoto sake with friendly staff. ¥550 appetizer; heated tobacco allowed. Book at weekends.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a creative Japanese restaurant opened in September 2024, mixing the casual feel of an izakaya with the elegance of kaiseki; the official page is on the site of its operator, LGK Co.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal ingredients in a relaxed setting (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 visitor from Kanto came for Kyoto vegetables rarely seen at home and liked the range of sake.
An October 2026 first-timer called the deep-fried dashimaki a first in a lifetime.
A July 2026 diner liked the food but found the air conditioning weak.

kyoto_dagashi_bar_a55.notes: [Dagashi bar · Kawaramachi Sanjo, all-you-can-eat snacks] A playful second-floor bar themed on after-school Heisei days: all-you-can-eat shelves of over 120 dagashi, time-limited drinks plans from about ¥2,000, board games, Wii, manga and costume props. Fun for groups and families; open to 5:00 on Saturday nights.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an all-you-can-eat dagashi bar opened in March 2017, with private rooms for groups and themed events.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 fan booked an event plan to sit in the seat where a favourite character had sat.
An April 2026 visitor lost track of time reading NARUTO among 150-odd board games and cosplay props.
A November 2025 visitor finally got the dagashi feast a strict childhood had forbidden.

kyoto_pontocho_surugaya.gf_detail: Ask. Warabi mochi made with bracken starch and kinako, yokan and mizu-yokan, plus a butter dorayaki (2024–26 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_pontocho_surugaya.vegan_detail: Ask. Warabi mochi with koshian and kinako and yokan are bean-based, but the butter dorayaki contains butter and egg (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_pontocho_surugaya.hours_raw: Mon and Thu–Sun 10:00–17:00; closed Tuesday and Wednesday; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cards accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Mostly take-away; a piece can be served on a plate to eat at the shop (August 2026). Popular items sell out — buy early on show days (May 2025). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Online orders via the official site (August 2026). On Pontocho south of Sanjo, 6 min from Keihan Sanjo (Tabelog).
kyoto_pontocho_surugaya.notes: [Wagashi · Pontocho, warabi mochi for over a century] A long-established wagashi shop behind a chidori noren on Pontocho, famous for its bite-sized hitokuchi warabi — wobbly hon-warabi mochi wrapped round smooth koshian in unsweetened kinako, made fresh to order — plus summer bamboo yokan, mizu-yokan and butter dorayaki. Take-away; closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a wagashi shop on Pontocho. A June 2024 review says it has served customers in Pontocho for over 120 years; a December 2025 review notes that items are made fresh in the back after ordering.
chef_bio.philosophy: Nothing kept pre-made; only the day's freshest pieces (December 2025 review).

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 visitor at the Kamogawa Odori found the warabi mochi sold out after the show and bought a butter dorayaki instead.
An August 2026 passer-by asked to eat a piece on the spot and was served it on a plate.
A July 2026 visitor took summer mizu-yokan down to the Kamo river to eat.

kyoto_kawamichiya_koshoan.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: soba with wheat, udon, tempura, curry soba thickened with starch and soy-based tsuyu (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kawamichiya_koshoan.vegan_detail: Not vegan: bonito-dashi tsuyu; duck and tempura toppings (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kawamichiya_koshoan.hours_raw: Tabelog: Sat and Sun 18:00–20:30 (last order 20:00); closed weekdays and holidays; temporary closures possible. Daytime at the same address and phone now runs as Cafe Lumen (opened 8 June 2026; separate listing) — a June 2026 reviewer says the house opens as a café at lunchtime and keeps irregular weekend dinner hours, posted on Instagram. Reservations taken. 20 seats: a large sunken-kotatsu table and tables; shoes off at the door; garden view. Non-smoking; children welcome. Cards, e-money and PayPay. A renovated machiya on Gokomachi above Takatsuji. Opened at this address 1 November 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kawamichiya_koshoan.notes: [Soba · Gokomachi above Takatsuji, a Kawamichiya noren-wake house] A shoes-off machiya soba house, a Kawamichiya branch family since 1879, serving duck nanban, tempura and Kyoto tanuki soba over a garden view. Since June 2026 the daytime trade runs here as Cafe Lumen; the Koshoan name now covers weekend evenings. Reviews are mixed — some found the broth flat or the soba lukewarm.

chef_bio.background: Run by 有限会社河道屋倖松庵 (NTA invoice register, via the Cafe Lumen listing at the same address). The Kyoto Bussan association says the house was founded in Meiji 12 (1879) when its first generation trained at 総本家 河道屋 and was granted the name (noren-wake), and that the fourth generation now runs it. It opened at this machiya on 1 November 2023 (Tabelog). Criticism: a broth tasting of "chemical seasonings" and overcooked soba (November 2024), wrong orders (July 2025), processed rather than fresh ginger (November 2025), and lukewarm soba with a long wait when short-staffed (May 2026).

anecdotes.text: May 2026: "Kawamichiya is famous for its soba bouro. Be cautious, as the branches of the family lineage are so complex that discussing one branch in another can lead to cold responses."
January 2025: "Upon entering the establishment, removing your shoes is required. You can see the garden from inside, creating a spacious atmosphere."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 河道屋倖松庵、そば・うどん・居酒屋、下京区橘町448、阪急京都河原町駅10番出口から徒歩5分、土・日 18:00〜20:30 (L.O. 20:00)、平日・祝日休み、予約可、20席、掘りごたつ、禁煙、子供可、カード・電子マネー・PayPay可、2023年11月1日オープン、町家を改装した空間でそば、おばんざい、日本酒。京都物産出品協会: (有)河道屋倖松庵、創業は明治十二年、初代が総本家・河道屋にて修行ののち暖簾分け、当代四代目。国税庁インボイス公表サイト: 有限会社河道屋倖松庵 (T4130002006904)。口コミ (2024年9月〜2026年5月、英語): 鴨なんばの大盛りとご飯1,550円、鴨せいろ、天ぷらそば、夏野菜のカレーそば1,400円、たぬきそば、揚げだし豆腐、生麩田楽、日本酒、靴を脱いで上がる、庭が見える、化学調味料の味 (2024年11月)、注文違い (2025年7月)、おろし生姜が既製品 (2025年11月)、そばがぬるい (2026年5月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Shoes off; weekend evenings only under this name.

kyoto_cafe_lumen_takatsuji.notes: [Café · Gokomachi above Takatsuji, soba and omurice in a Kawamichiya machiya] The daytime face of the Kawamichiya Koshoan soba house: a calm, grey-and-wood machiya café where you cut open a creamy omurice or have the family's soba with tempura or herring, plus shaved ice in summer. Shoes off; mobile ordering. Closed Wednesday and Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 8 June 2026 (Tabelog) in the machiya of 河道屋倖松庵, a soba house founded in Meiji 12 (1879) as a noren-wake of 総本家 河道屋 (Kyoto Bussan association). A July 2026 reviewer writes that the first generation "trained at the main branch of Kawadoya before branching out" and that the soba comes from the family's own noodle works; the Tabelog invoice number belongs to 有限会社河道屋倖松庵. Reviewers note a gentle grey-and-wood interior with vintage furniture; one found the soba "didn't seem to be handmade, but it was decent" (July 2026).

anecdotes.text: August 2026: "There was a detailed explanation on how to open the omelet, and even as a novice, I was able to do it perfectly."
September 2026: "The soba was from Kawado-ya and exceeded my expectations in quality."

kyoto_toto_kissa_gion.gf_detail: Ask: coffee, café au lait, milk tea and lemon squash; no food described (2015–2026 reviews).
kyoto_toto_kissa_gion.vegan_detail: Ask: black coffee and lemon squash may suit; café au lait and milk tea do not (2015–2026 reviews).
kyoto_toto_kissa_gion.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:00–18:00; hours may change. Cash only per Tabelog (no cards, e-money or QR). Non-smoking (January 2025). Counter and bench seats in a white room with light-green chairs (January 2016). At the end of a narrow alley off the north side of Shijo-dori in Gion, under a green "charcoal-brewed coffee" sign (2016–2025).
kyoto_toto_kissa_gion.notes: [Kissa · alley off Shijo, Gion, charcoal-roast coffee] A quiet retro coffee shop hidden at the end of a narrow alley off Shijo, behind a green door: Hagiwara charcoal-roast coffee, a good iced café au lait and regulars at the counter. Cash only; open daily 11:00–18:00.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers since 2011 describe a hidden café behind a green door at the end of an alley off Shijo, a white room with light-green chairs, regulars at the counter and freshly ground coffee from Hagiwara Coffee of Kobe (July 2025). It is non-smoking, unusual for its kind (January 2025).

anecdotes.text: July 2025: "The atmosphere felt a bit like a snack bar… but I was pleasantly surprised to find they offered very delicious coffee! It seems they use coffee beans from Kobe's Hagiwara Coffee."
January 2016: "Deep into the long alley typical of Kyoto, you'll find a green door. Surrounded by mosaic glass, the outside world is completely shut out."

kyoto_raclette_loom.gf_detail: Ask. A rice-flour raclette taiyaki is described as gluten-free (July–September 2026 reviews), but pizza, pasta and gratin come from the same kitchen; no information on shared fryers or surfaces.
kyoto_raclette_loom.vegan_detail: Not vegan: raclette cheese poured over most dishes, steak and sausage (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_raclette_loom.hours_raw: Monday–Wednesday and Friday–Sunday 14:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); closed Thursday, though it may open on a Thursday that is or precedes a public holiday (Tabelog; official site). Raclette taiyaki served 14:00–17:00 only, 20 a day, with a one-drink minimum (July 2026 reviews). Reservations accepted; courses ¥5,500–7,000, a 2-hour all-you-can-drink banquet course ¥5,800 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay); no e-money or QR (Tabelog; official site). 28 seats at counter and tables; non-smoking, with a smoking area (Tabelog). English menu; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). The toilet is reached by stepping outside (December 2025). 5 min walk from Keihan Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn, 7 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi (Tabelog). Opened 10 January 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_raclette_loom.notes: [Raclette bistro · Teramachi-Matsubara, machiya] A wood-warm, century-old townhouse with a small back garden where melted raclette is poured over steak, vegetables and pizza at your table, by a chef trained in Italian and French cooking. Afternoons bring a novel rice-flour taiyaki under raclette. Opens 14:00; closed Thursday. English menu. Chilly in winter, one diner found.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a café and bar in a renovated Kyoto townhouse of about 100 years, serving raclette dishes by a chef who trained in Italian and French cuisine. Opened 10 January 2023 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Handmade dishes with raclette poured in front of the guest (official site).

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 diner noticed many international guests chatting happily with staff who spoke good English.
A December 2025 visitor found the room cold even after asking for more heat, with the toilet reached by stepping outside, but praised the food.
A July 2026 reviewer tried the new raclette taiyaki of rice flour, served only from 14:00 to 17:00.

kyoto_light_shokai.gf_detail: Not GF for meals: thick toast, French toast, egg sandwiches and monaka (2024–2026 reviews). Drinks only.
kyoto_light_shokai.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee, tea, chai and kombu tea are plant-based; the food has butter, egg and milk (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_light_shokai.hours_raw: Café: Tuesday–Friday 12:00–20:00; Saturday and the day before a public holiday 13:00–20:00; Sunday 10:00–20:00; bar time Saturday, Sunday and the day before a holiday 20:30–23:00 (last order 22:30); the shop's note also lists Friday among bar nights; closed Monday; other closing days irregular (Tabelog). No charge at bar time (Tabelog original BAR TIME NO CHARGE). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 22 seats including sofas; non-smoking since about 2025 (Tabelog). An antique shop and café; some pieces are for sale; exhibitions, Noh and film screenings, usually upstairs (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). In a narrow alley just south of Sanjo between Teramachi and Shinkyogoku, opposite MOVIX: turn at the Mishima-tei corner; 4 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_light_shokai.notes: [Antique kissa · Teramachi-Sanjo alley, cash only] A long, dim café crammed with antique clocks, lamps, cellos and dolls — some for sale — down an alley a step from Sanjo. Hand-ground coffee, cream soda, thick toast and a lucky-cat monaka; weekend evenings it turns bar, with no charge. Exhibitions upstairs. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a coffee shop near Teramachi-Sanjo that also sells antique furniture, holding occasional events such as live Noh and film screenings, usually on the second floor. A December 2024 reviewer reports the name refers to the Wright brothers, and that the shop is the model for the antique shop in the mystery novel series Holmes at Sanjo in Kyoto.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 visitor was seated beside a doll, with hits by The Peanuts playing, and learned the cat-shaped monaka bears the name Matabei after the shop's late mascot cat.
A February 2026 guest found the master dressed like a butler, in keeping with the maze-like room of antique clocks.
A March 2025 group waited nearly an hour for three drinks — perhaps a forgotten order — but forgave it for the atmosphere and the friendly server.

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; quiet antique room; no charge at bar time.

kyoto_kensui_nishiki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, dashi-based obanzai and simmered fish (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kensui_nishiki.hours_raw: Daily 15:00–24:00 (last orders food 23:00, drinks 23:30) (Tabelog). The shop's own site gives 12:30–24:00 on Monday and Wednesday–Saturday and 15:00–24:00 on Tuesday, Sunday, holidays and the day before holidays (official site, read 2026-11-07). Reservations accepted; courses with 150 minutes of all-you-can-drink, including seven or more sakes, from ¥4,000 (official site). Opened 2 December 2013 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kensui_nishiki.notes: [Sake izakaya · Nishiki-Takakura, 2F, smoking] A second-floor sake and obanzai tavern on Nishiki: obanzai platters, sashimi, simmered fish and a long list of sake, with good-value all-you-can-drink courses and private rooms for groups. Smoking is allowed throughout. Some reviewers found the food ordinary for the price.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an izakaya of 45 seats opened 2 December 2013 on the second floor on Nishikikoji. Its site, styled 烏丸錦店, offers sake from around Japan with fish and obanzai, and links one related venue, a karaoke party space in Kawaramachi.
chef_bio.philosophy: Sake from around Japan with obanzai and market-fresh fish (official site).

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 visitor arriving late at Nishiki asked whether a meal without alcohol was fine and was welcomed in; three obanzai came to just under ¥1,000.
A March 2026 work party was shown to a private room at the back, surprised to be drinking on the second floor of a Nishiki building.
A November 2025 diner, who booked because it allows smoking, found the food average and a little pricey but the service quick.

kyoto_gion_kawamoto.gf_detail: Ask. Courses include a fried course, saba sushi, red miso soup and fugu karaage; soy and ponzu throughout; no gluten information (official site; 2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_kawamoto.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish courses, fugu and dashi (official site).
kyoto_gion_kawamoto.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday–Saturday and the day before a holiday 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); Sunday and holidays 18:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Wednesday and one Sunday a month; may close early when food runs out, and may close suddenly — confirm a booking by phone (Tabelog; official site). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Saba sushi and chirimen sansho to take away (Tabelog). 5 min walk from Keihan Gion-Shijo Stn exit 9 (official site).
kyoto_gion_kawamoto.notes: [Kyoto cuisine · Gion Kiyomoto-cho, saba sushi and fugu] A small, calm Gion restaurant of counter seats and two booths where a couple serves seasonal Kyoto vegetables and fish: a 10-dish course ending in the house's thick saba sushi, or a winter fugu course of sashimi, grilled fugu and hot pot. Closed Wednesday; smoking allowed. One 2026 guest found the saba sushi a little salty.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a Gion restaurant serving Japanese cuisine of seasonal Kyoto vegetables and fresh seafood with sake from around Japan, in a room of counter, table and private seating. An August 2025 reviewer describes it as run by a friendly couple.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal Kyoto vegetables and fresh seafood with sake from around Japan (official site).

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 diner at the counter, visiting an acquaintance's favourite, enjoyed the warm welcome from the friendly couple who run it.
An October 2025 guest had the fugu course and liked the long-established feel of the room.
A May 2024 diner remembered a fluffy dashimaki rich with dashi and planned to return in fugu season.

kyoto_roji_tonomoto.gf_detail: Ask. Sushi with soy sauce, homemade sesame miso and a fish-bone dashi poured over the lunch bowl; dinner adds dishes such as shark fin, Chateaubriand and a choice of soba, curry udon or yuzu ramen to finish. The shop asks guests to mention allergies in advance and says ingredients can be changed (own site).
kyoto_roji_tonomoto.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sushi and seafood throughout, with a fish-bone dashi (own site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_roji_tonomoto.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 11:00–14:30 and 17:00–23:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, same day possible depending on bookings; same-day cancellations are charged 100% (own site). Service charge 10% (own site, original サービス料を10％頂戴しております). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 24 seats: 11 at the counter, a 4-seat tatami room and 12 at tables, with private rooms; smoking only in the private room (Tabelog). kyoto_roji_tonomoto.notes: [Sushi and kappo · Miyagawa-cho alley, hitsumabushi at lunch] A sushi and kappo restaurant down a lantern-lit alley in Miyagawa-cho, with a counter, a tatami room and private rooms around a small garden. Lunch is a much-praised seafood hitsumabushi (¥4,980) finished with fish-bone dashi; dinner courses run from about ¥20,000. 10% service charge; for foreign guests only, a ¥12,000 sushi course plus service. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text describes a chef with over 22 years of experience cooking Japanese food and sushi, with semi-custom dishes on request. A September 2026 diner found the head chef friendly and fun to talk with.
chef_bio.philosophy: The food, the dishes, the plating and the service are an art of the moment; the aim is for each meal to stay with the guest as a “work” (own site).

anecdotes.text: A notice dated 10 April 2026 says foreign guests can now order à la carte, and offers a sushi course for foreign guests only — 海外の方限定になりますが、寿司コース 12,000円＋サービス料 (starter, 10–12 nigiri, dessert).
A November 2026 diner asked for a second bowl of rice, set aside some sea bream, added sesame sauce and poured the fish-bone broth over to make sea-bream chazuke.
An October 2026 visitor noted the lunch uses the same fish as the dinner menu.

kyoto_wagyu_ryotei_bungo_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Wagyu courses served by the staff — raw-beef dishes, grilled Wagyu, sukiyaki over rice, Kyoto vegetables; no gluten information (own site; 2025 reviews).
kyoto_wagyu_ryotei_bungo_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every course is built on Wagyu (own site).
kyoto_wagyu_ryotei_bungo_gion.hours_raw: By reservation: lunch seatings 12:00–14:00 and dinner seatings 17:00–20:30 (first sitting from 17:00, second from 20:00) (own site; Tabelog). Closing days not listed. Same-day reservations possible; credit-card payment (own site). The site asks foreign guests to book by email through the booking site (original 海外からお越しのお客様は予約サイトからメールにてお願い致します). Courses are generally for guests of middle-school age and up; a private room costs ¥5,500 a head, waived for children under school age, who can have a ¥3,500 yakiniku-bowl set at dinner; one drink per person (Tabelog). Tabelog says a service fee may be added, but its Japanese original gives no amount. Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 32 seats: a 10-seat counter and private rooms for 2, 2 (detached), 6 and 8 (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On Shinbashi-dori in a building designated by Kyoto City, 7 min from Keihan Gion-Shijo (own site; Tabelog). Opened 5 February 2023 (own site).
kyoto_wagyu_ryotei_bungo_gion.notes: [Wagyu courses · Gion Shinbashi-dori, all-serve] A Wagyu restaurant in a listed building on Gion’s Shinbashi-dori where staff cook and serve every course of Oita Wagyu — raw-beef dishes, steak, sukiyaki over rice — at a counter or in private rooms. Dinner ¥19,580–35,200, lunch ¥13,000–25,000; all-grilled versions for those who avoid raw meat. Foreign guests are asked to book by email; a service fee may apply. Flagged: the operator was not found.

chef_bio.background: The brand site lists two shops: 和牛料亭 bungo inside Nazuna 京都 椿通 and this Gion shop. The operating company was not found. A July 2026 reviewer describes young staff who speak English and are friendly.
chef_bio.philosophy: Bringing out the true appeal of meat through “yakiniku you don’t grill yourself”, with tableware and drinks chosen to match (own site).

anecdotes.text: A January 2025 diner on the Premium course singled out the sukiyaki eaten with rice and the fresh Kyoto vegetables.
A July 2026 diner found the cooking more show than substance and wanted a wider wine list, but praised the freshly cooked rice.
