chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text describes Kyoto-style okonomiyaki and teppanyaki built on local ingredients such as Kyoto pork and Kujo green onions, with Kyoto whisky for overseas guests. Reviewers praise staff who explain the toppings and recommendations (December 2025, June 2026).

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 visitor was surprised to be served a luxurious Pon juice when ordering orange juice.
A December 2025 diner arriving just after 10 pm on a Friday found it still quiet, and recommends the horumon.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe friendly chefs at the counter who are easy to talk with (October 2025, April 2026). One regular has come for nearly 50 years, since student days (August 2025).

An October 2025 diner enjoyed seeing the bill worked out on an abacus.

kyoto_ajinoya_urateramachi.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Ura-Teramachi, a 1950s griddle house] An old-school okonomiyaki shop on the back lane behind Shinkyogoku, founded in 1950 and no relation to the Namba Ajinoya. Staff cook pork or squid okonomiyaki (about ¥1,000) on your table's griddle; try the Kyoto-style negiyaki with Kujo onion and soy sauce. Cash only; no children; closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: A July 2026 reviewer says the shop was founded in 1950 and, asking the staff, was told it has no connection with 味乃家 in Namba, Osaka. Reviewers (2024–2026) describe a long-established shop with plastic food samples outside and teppan at every table.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto-style negiyaki with Kujo green onion and soy sauce.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 Namba fan came to ask whether the two Ajinoya are related, and was told the two are unrelated.
A February 2025 visitor from Tohoku, escaping the cold, mixed the soy sauce and the table sauce half and half on the negiyaki.
A March 2025 diner tried natto okonomiyaki for the first time.

kyoto_ebi_bar_origami.notes: [Shrimp bar · Nishikiyamachi, red-shrimp shabu-shabu late] A two-floor shrimp bar off the Shijo end of Nishikiyamachi, open till 1 am (2 am Saturdays). anecdotes.text: A June 2025 family of four women came for a shrimp feast and ordered extra shrimp for the hot pot.
A September 2026 shrimp lover had passed the door countless times before finally going in.
A February 2026 second-round guest was surprised to find meat dishes too, and liked the shrimp peperoncino.

kyoto_yoshibe.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fugu, hamo and seasonal fish courses (official site).
kyoto_yoshibe.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 14:00), dinner 17:30–22:30 (last order 22:00); closing days not fixed (Tabelog). The official site gives 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:30 — check. Reservations taken; often fully booked (Tabelog; February 2025). Cards accepted (Tabelog; official site). 10% service charge in private rooms only (Tabelog). 35 seats: counter and tatami rooms on two floors, parties up to 25; shoes off; English menu; designated smoking area (Tabelog; official site; October 2024). Down a lane off Shijo just west of the Kamo River bridge, near Minami-za, 3 min from Kawaramachi or Gion-Shijo Stn (official site; Tabelog).
kyoto_yoshibe.notes: [Fugu & hamo kappo · Shijo Ohashi, since 1935] A family-run kappo tucked between the Kamo and Takase rivers by Shijo bridge, serving fugu in winter and hamo in summer since 1935. The fugu course runs from tessa sashimi and creamy shirako to hot pot and zosui (about ¥18,000); try the flaming fin sake. Counter or tatami; shoes off.

chef_bio.background: The official site says the first-generation owner founded the restaurant in 1935 (Showa 10) and it has been loved by locals for more than 80 years. Reviewers (2024–2026) describe a head chef working with the proprietress and staff, and an August 2026 diner chatted with the owner, the owner’s wife and mother; a February 2026 diner was served natural fugu from Shimonoseki.
chef_bio.specialty: Fugu courses in winter; hamo in summer.

anecdotes.text: A December 2024 lunch guest noticed fugu fins hung outside to dry.
A February 2026 diner celebrating passing a national exam praised the teamwork of the head chef and the friendly proprietress.
An August 2026 husband booked a hamo dinner for a wife’s birthday after hamo caught the wife’s eye on TV.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 割烹・ふぐ料理 京都 由兵衛、京都市下京区西石垣通四条下ル斉藤町118、鴨川と高瀬川に挟まれた静かな佇まい、昭和10年に初代が創業して80年余り、夏季は鱧、冬季はふぐ、季節の京会席コース (全8品程度、付き出し2品、お造り3種盛、お吸い物、焼き物、焚き合わせ、油物、季節のご飯、水物、御予算に応じる)、営業時間11:30〜15:00・17:00〜22:30 (L.O.22:00)、不定休、35席 (宴会25名まで)、カード可。食べログ: ふぐ・日本料理、12:00〜15:00・17:30〜22:30、個室のみ飲食代の10%、英語メニュー、持ち込み可。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 南座の近く、四条大橋の手前の細い路地、靴を脱ぐ、カウンターと座敷、2階、ふぐのコース (てっさ、焼きふぐ、唐揚げ、ふぐ鍋、白子焼き、白子の刺身、雑炊)、松コース18,000円、ひれ酒、下関の天然とらふぐ、鱧しゃぶ、鱧の天ぷら、締めはそうめんか雑炊、大将と女将とスタッフの連携、店主と奥さんとお母さん。

kyoto_kyo_yakiniku_kura_teramachi.gf_detail: Ask. Yakiniku with soy, miso and sesame seasonings, kimchi, bibimbap and soups; no gluten information is published (Tabelog menu; reviews).
kyoto_kyo_yakiniku_kura_teramachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakiniku restaurant. Kimchi, namul and grilled vegetables are on the menu — ask (Tabelog menu).
kyoto_kyo_yakiniku_kura_teramachi.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30), dinner 17:00–22:30 (last order 22:00), daily (Tabelog). Reservations taken. Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). Appetizer fee ¥418 (Tabelog). 44 seats (4 at the counter, 40 at tables) over two floors; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome; English and Chinese menus (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Lunch sets come with a free large rice and free oolong tea; no horumon at lunch (2024–2025 reviews). Meat is cooked on a flat griddle, not a grill (October 2025). In an old storehouse-style building on Teramachi just south of Shijo, near Takashimaya, by exit 10 of Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; January 2026).
kyoto_kyo_yakiniku_kura_teramachi.notes: [Yakiniku · Teramachi by Shijo, wagyu at fair prices] A two-floor yakiniku house in a former storehouse on Teramachi, a step from Takashimaya. Kuroge wagyu platters, Kyoto beef and horumon at evening prices from under ¥1,000 a plate; lunch sets of steak or karubi with free large rice. Open daily, with English and Chinese menus.

chef_bio.background: Opened in October 2005 (Tabelog). Run by Bal Flower (バルフラワー), a Kyoto food company whose site lists two Italian restaurants (クアトロ) besides 蔵 寺町店, along with a frozen-food division (bal-flower.co.jp, read 2026-11-07). The shop describes a calm room in a former storehouse.

anecdotes.text: An April 2025 visitor, finding famous yakiniku places full or too dear, ate tongue, skirt, rib and hoso here for under ¥5,000.
A January 2026 diner found reasonable lunch prices even on New Year’s Day, when nearby places charged tourist prices.
A November 2026 first-timer was drawn in by yukgaejang on the menu board outside.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京焼肉 蔵 寺町店、焼肉・ホルモン・韓国料理、京都市下京区寺町通貞安前之町609、阪急河原町駅10番出口すぐ、11:30〜14:00 (L.O.13:30)・17:00〜22:30 (L.O.22:00)、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、お通し代418円、44席 (カウンター4、テーブル40)、禁煙、子ども可、英語・中国語メニュー、2005年10月1日オープン、運営はバルフラワー (公式サイトにイタリアン クアトロ2店と蔵 寺町店)。メニュー (2026年6月): 黒毛和牛6種盛り4,928円、3種盛り3,278円、京都牛ロース1,188円、カルビ・ハラミ858円、九条ねぎをのせたカルビ3,278円、ごま油とねぎの薄切り牛タン1,738円、西京味噌味の大腸858円、キムチ638円、飲み放題付きコース6,500円。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): ランチの焼肉定食、ステーキ定食、カルビ丼、ユッケジャン、八代目儀兵衛のお米、ご飯大盛り無料、ウーロン茶無料、ランチにホルモンはない、鉄板で焼く、2階もある、髙島屋の近く。
